modules.title: Brazil Business Culture & Labour Law (CLT)
modules.description: Brazilian employment compliance under Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho (CLT), covering key obligations, severance, and the unique Brazilian workplace culture.
learningObjectives: Apply key CLT employment obligations for Brazilian operations
Manage FGTS (Severance Indemnity Fund) and social security contributions
Navigate Brazilian union relations and collective bargaining
Understand Brazilian jeitinho and relationship-based workplace culture
modules.audience: HR and managers in Brazilian operations

modules.title: Brazil LGPD Data Privacy Compliance
modules.description: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) compliance training — Brazil's comprehensive data protection law, analogous to GDPR.
learningObjectives: Understand LGPD's ten legal bases for data processing
Handle data subject rights requests within required timelines
Apply privacy by design principles
Report data incidents to ANPD
modules.audience: All Brazilian employees handling personal data

modules.title: Latin American Leadership & Personalismo
modules.description: Leadership development tailored to Latin American cultures, exploring personalismo, power distance, family-oriented values, and relationship-driven business.
learningObjectives: Lead with personalismo and authentic relationship-building
Navigate high power distance in Latin American teams
Balance family obligations with business commitments sensitively
Inspire and motivate through purpose-driven leadership
modules.audience: Managers and leaders across Latin America

modules.title: Argentina Business Environment
modules.description: Business culture and economic context for Argentina, covering communication style, financial volatility navigation, and relationship-building in Buenos Aires and beyond.
learningObjectives: Navigate Argentina's passionate and expressive communication culture
Manage business in an economically volatile environment
Build relationships through Argentine social customs
Understand political and regulatory context for business decisions

modules.title: Anti-Corruption in Latin America (Lava Jato Lessons)
modules.description: Anti-corruption compliance for LATAM operations, drawing on lessons from Brazil's Lava Jato and incorporating local anti-corruption laws (Lei Anticorrupção, etc.).
learningObjectives: Apply Brazil's Clean Company Act (Lei Anticorrupção) requirements
Navigate anti-corruption risks in public procurement in Latin America
Manage third-party intermediary due diligence
Build a robust compliance program culture
modules.audience: All employees in Latin American operations

modules.title: Colombia & Pacific Alliance Business
modules.description: Business insights for Colombia and the Pacific Alliance (Chile, Colombia, Mexico, Peru) covering trade integration, cultural norms, and key sectors.
learningObjectives: Understand the Pacific Alliance market integration benefits
Navigate Colombian business culture and relationship norms
Identify business opportunities across Pacific Alliance members
Manage compliance across multiple regulatory environments

modules.title: Portuguese Language for Business
modules.description: Business Portuguese for non-native speakers, focusing on Brazilian Portuguese and the unique features of Brazilian business communication.
learningObjectives: Conduct professional communications in Brazilian Portuguese
Write effective business emails and reports in Portuguese
Navigate Brazilian Portuguese colloquialisms in the workplace
Present confidently in Portuguese-language business settings

modules.title: Mining & Natural Resources Safety (LATAM)
modules.description: Safety and health training for mining, oil and gas, and natural resources operations in Latin America — Peru, Chile, Colombia, Brazil, and Bolivia.
learningObjectives: Apply LATAM mining safety regulations and international standards
Implement risk controls for high-hazard extractive operations
Manage environmental and social impact in LATAM communities
Respond to emergency incidents in remote locations
modules.audience: Operations and safety teams in extractive industries

modules.title: Digital Banking & Fintech in Latin America
modules.description: Understanding LATAM's fintech revolution — PIX in Brazil, Nequi in Colombia, Mercado Pago — and the opportunity for financial inclusion across the region.
learningObjectives: Understand the LATAM fintech ecosystem and key players
Apply Open Banking frameworks in Brazilian and Mexican markets
Manage digital payments and financial inclusion strategies
Navigate regulatory sandboxes across LATAM fintech markets

modules.title: Diversity in Latin America — Race, Ethnicity & Inclusion
modules.description: DEI training addressing Latin America's complex racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic diversity — Afro-descendants, Indigenous peoples, and racial equity at work.
learningObjectives: Understand racial and ethnic diversity in LATAM societies
Address racial equity and colorism in workplace decisions
Promote Indigenous rights and representation
Build socioeconomically inclusive workplaces

modules.title: Agribusiness & Sustainability in Brazil
modules.description: Sustainability and compliance training for Brazil's agribusiness sector, covering deforestation law, Amazon protection, and ESG standards for supply chains.
learningObjectives: Apply Brazil's Forest Code and deforestation monitoring requirements
Manage Amazon supply chain due diligence
Meet international ESG expectations for Brazilian agricultural exports
Implement sustainable farming practices
modules.audience: Agribusiness, supply chain, and sustainability teams

modules.title: Chile Business Excellence
modules.description: Chile business culture and regulatory environment — Latin America's most stable economy with strong institutions and a sophisticated business community.
learningObjectives: Understand Chilean business formality and professional norms
Navigate Chile's well-developed regulatory and legal environment
Build relationships in Santiago's corporate ecosystem
Identify business opportunities in Chile's key sectors

modules.title: Mental Health & Wellbeing in LATAM
modules.description: Workplace mental health support adapted for Latin American contexts, addressing stigma, machismo culture, and building psychologically safe teams.
learningObjectives: Recognize mental health challenges in LATAM workplace cultures
Navigate machismo culture and its impact on help-seeking behavior
Create psychologically safe environments in LATAM teams
Access and promote mental health resources

modules.title: Spanish Language Immersion for Brazil
modules.description: Business Spanish for Brazilian professionals working with Spanish-speaking Latin American counterparts across the region.
learningObjectives: Communicate effectively in business Spanish
Navigate similarities and differences between Spanish and Portuguese
Build relationships with Spanish-speaking LATAM colleagues
Conduct meetings and negotiations in Spanish
modules.audience: Brazilian professionals engaging with Spanish-speaking LATAM

modules.title: Peru & Andean Business Culture
modules.description: Business culture for Peru and the Andean region, covering Indigenous business traditions, mining sector dynamics, and Lima's cosmopolitan corporate culture.
learningObjectives: Understand Peru's cultural diversity across Lima, coastal, and highland regions
Navigate community engagement requirements in extractive industries
Apply free, prior, and informed consent (FPIC) principles with Indigenous communities
Build trust with Peruvian government and business stakeholders
modules.audience: Professionals engaging with Peru and Andean countries

modules.title: ESG Reporting for Latin American Companies
modules.description: ESG disclosure and sustainability reporting training for LATAM companies, covering GRI, SASB, CDP, and stock exchange sustainability requirements.
learningObjectives: Apply GRI Standards for sustainability reporting
Meet B3 (Brazil) and Santiago Stock Exchange ESG disclosure requirements

Integrate TCFD climate risk disclosures
